mapper.select: SELECT id, school_id, teacher_id, term_id, week_day, start_date, end_date, start_time, end_time, classroom, status FROM course_offering WHERE id = #{offeringId}
SELECT id, school_id, teacher_id, term_id, week_day, start_date, end_date, start_time, end_time, classroom, status FROM course_offering WHERE id = #{offeringId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT DISTINCT a.original_session_date FROM schedule_adjustment a JOIN lesson_session ls ON ls.id = a.session_id AND ls.school_id = a.school_id WHERE ls.offering_id = #{offeringId} AND a.status = 'APPLIED' ORDER BY a.original_session_date

SELECT ls.id, ls.school_id AS schoolId, ls.offering_id AS offeringId, o.offering_code AS offeringCode, c.course_name AS courseName, t.full_name AS teacherName, ls.session_date AS sessionDate, ls.start_time AS startTime, ls.end_time AS endTime, ls.classroom, ls.status, ls.notes, COUNT(a.id) AS recordedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status IN ('PRESENT', 'LATE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS attendedCount FROM lesson_session ls JOIN course_offering o ON o.id = ls.offering_id JOIN course c ON c.id = o.course_id JOIN teacher t ON t.id = o.teacher_id LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.session_id = ls.id WHERE ls.offering_id = #{offeringId} GROUP BY ls.id, ls.school_id, ls.offering_id, o.offering_code, c.course_name, t.full_name, ls.session_date, ls.start_time, ls.end_time, ls.classroom, ls.status, ls.notes ORDER BY ls.session_date, ls.start_time

SELECT ls.id, ls.school_id, ls.offering_id, o.teacher_id, ls.session_date, ls.start_time, ls.status, o.status AS offering_status FROM lesson_session ls JOIN course_offering o ON o.id = ls.offering_id WHERE ls.id = #{sessionId}
SELECT ls.id, ls.school_id, ls.offering_id, ls.session_date, ls.start_time, ls.status FROM lesson_session ls WHERE ls.id = #{sessionId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id AS offering_id, school_id, teacher_id, status AS offering_status FROM course_offering WHERE id = #{offeringId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT st.id AS studentId, st.student_no AS studentNo, st.full_name AS studentName, sc.class_name AS className, a.id, COALESCE( a.status, CASE WHEN lr.status = 'APPROVED' THEN 'LEAVE' END ) AS status, a.status AS recordedStatus, a.remark, a.recorded_at AS recordedAt, u.display_name AS recordedByName, lr.id AS leaveRequestId, lr.reason AS leaveReason, lr.reviewed_at AS leaveApprovedAt FROM lesson_session ls JOIN enrollment e ON e.offering_id = ls.offering_id AND ( ( e.enrolled_at <= TIMESTAMP(ls.session_date, ls.start_time) AND ( e.canceled_at IS NULL OR e.canceled_at >= TIMESTAMP(ls.session_date, ls.start_time) ) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance historic WHERE historic.session_id = ls.id AND historic.student_id = e.student_id ) ) JOIN student st ON st.id = e.student_id JOIN school_class sc ON sc.id = st.class_id LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.session_id = ls.id AND a.student_id = st.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.recorded_by LEFT JOIN leave_request lr ON lr.session_id = ls.id AND lr.student_id = st.id AND lr.status = 'APPROVED' WHERE ls.id = #{sessionId} AND (ls.status != 'COMPLETED' OR a.id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY sc.grade, sc.class_name, st.student_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance ( school_id, offering_id, session_id, student_id, status, recorded_by, remark, recorded_at ) VALUES ( #{schoolId}, #{offeringId}, #{sessionId}, #{studentId}, #{status}, #{recordedBy}, #{remark}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), recorded_by = VALUES(recorded_by), remark = VALUES(remark), recorded_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
